```{r}

# A function to ad compact letter significance display on a ggplot boxplot graph
cld_bxplot_wilcox <-
  function(data, x, y, significance = 0.05, plot, nudge = 0.05){
    if (kruskal.test(y,x)$p.value<0.05){
      box_rslt <- with(data,graphics::boxplot(y~x ,plot = F))
      
      loc_vec <- box_rslt$stats[nrow(box_rslt$stats),]
      
      wilcx_rslt <- with(data,pairwise.wilcox.test(x = y, g = x,p.adjust.method = 'holm'))
      temp <- wilcx_rslt$p.value
      
      # Make a square matrix to populate with the alpha values.
      n <- nrow(temp)
      mat.names <- c(colnames(temp), rownames(temp)[n])
      my.mat <- matrix(data = NA, nrow = n+1, ncol = n+1)
      colnames(my.mat) <- mat.names
      rownames(my.mat) <- mat.names
      
      # Add diagonal.
      for (i in 1:nrow(my.mat)) {
        my.mat[ i, i] <- 0
      }
      
      # Get vector of p.values
      stat <- na.exclude(as.vector(wilcx_rslt$p.value))
      
      # Add other cells to square matrix.
      k=1
      for (j in 1:(nrow(my.mat)-1)) {
        for (i in ((j+1):nrow(my.mat))) {
          my.mat[i,j] <-  my.mat[j,i] <- stat[k]
          k=k+1
        }
      }
      cld_vec <- multcompView::multcompLetters(my.mat, threshold=significance)
      
      #df with the letters
      x_df <- c(1:length(cld_vec$Letters))
      y_df <- box_rslt$stats[nrow(box_rslt$stats),]
      cbd <- cld_vec$Letters
      ltr_df <- data.frame(x_df, y_df, cbd)
      
      #get coord of the graph
      plt1 <- ggplot2::ggplot_build(plot)
      xmin = plt1 $layout$panel_params[[1]]$x.range[1]
      xmax = plt1 $layout$panel_params[[1]]$x.range[2]
      ymin = plt1 $layout$panel_params[[1]]$y.range[1]
      ymax = plt1 $layout$panel_params[[1]]$y.range[2]
      lmts <- list(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax)
      y.range <- lmts$ymax - lmts$ymin
      y.nudge <- nudge * y.range
      
      cld <- list(ltr_df = ltr_df, y.nudge = y.nudge)
      
      return(plot +
               annotate(geom="text", x=cld$ltr_df$x_df, y=cld$ltr_df$y_df+cld$y.nudge, label=cld$ltr_df$cbd))
    }
    else {return(plot)}
  }
```

### Leaf traits

```{r import_data, echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
data_leaf <- read.csv("data/data_art1.csv") #load
data_leaf$Trtmt <- as.factor(data_leaf$Trtmt) # treatment as factor
levels(data_leaf$Trtmt) <- c("R-D","I-D","P-D","R-W","I-W","P-W") # change treatment code
stress_order <- data_leaf %>%
    group_by(Trtmt)%>%
    summarise(mean_Flowers=mean(Flowers))%>%
    arrange(desc(mean_Flowers))
data_leaf %<>% 
  mutate(Trtmt = forcats::fct_relevel(Trtmt,as.vector(stress_order$Trtmt))) # change level order to increasing stress (decreasing fitness)
data_leaf %<>%
  mutate(LMA = DM/(((8*pi*((8)/2)^2))*10^-6)) # Leaf surface = 8 disk of 8 mm diameter => 8disks*pi*((diam/2)^2) * 10^-6 to get m^2
```

```{r}
micro_16s$sample_table %<>%
    mutate(Trtmt=forcats::fct_relevel(Trtmt,as.vector(stress_order$Trtmt)))
micro_its$sample_table %<>%
    mutate(Trtmt=forcats::fct_relevel(Trtmt,as.vector(stress_order$Trtmt)))
rm(stress_order)
```

Variables:
-   *FM*, *DM* and *TM* : *Fresh*, *Dry* and *Turgid* mass respectively (g)
-   *mu_thick* : leaf thickness (cm)
-   *LDMC* : Leaf dry mass content (g.g\^-1)
-   *RWC* : Relative Water Content (%)
-   *WHC* : Water Holding Capacity (gH20.m\^-2)
-   *Leaves* : Leaves
-   *Pl_H* : Plant height (cm)
-   *LL_H* : Youngest mature leaf length (cm)
-   *LL_W* : Youngest mature leaf width (cm)
-   *chloro* : Leaf chlorophyll content (µg.cm\^-2)
-   *FvFm* : PSII yield
-   *ETRmax* : maximal electron transfert rate (µmol photon.m^-2.s^-1)
-   *Water_pot* : water potential (MPa?)
-   *C.N_leaf* : Leaf C/N ratio
-   *SS_leaf* : Leaf soluble sugars (µg.mg\^-1)
-   *Starch_leaf* : Leaf starch (µg.mg\^-1)
-   *mean_trich_diam_inf* : abaxial face trichome diameter (mm)
-   *mean_trich_diam_sup* : adaxial face trichome diameter (mm)
-   *inf_trich_dens* : abaxial face trichome density (nb.mm\^-2)
-   *sup_trich_dens* : adaxial face trichome density (nb.mm\^-2)
-   *sto_dens* : stomatal density (nb.mm\^-2), only abaxial face, hypostomatous species
-   *LMA* : Leaf Mass Area (g.m\^-2)
-   *C-*, *N-* and *P-mg* : Carbon, Nitrogen and Phosphorus content (mg.mg\^-1)
-   *Flowers* : Flowers produced

# II Make Graphs

## Dataset smry
```{r}
dl <- data_leaf%>%
    group_by(Trtmt)%>%
    summarise(sample_size=n(),
              data_type="Phenotype") 
db <- micro_16s$sample_table%>%
    group_by(Trtmt)%>%
    summarise(sample_size=n(),
              data_type="16s") 
df <- micro_its$sample_table%>%
    group_by(Trtmt)%>%
    summarise(sample_size=n(),
              data_type="ITS")
d <- rbind(dl,db)%>%
    rbind(df)

pdsmry <- 
d %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Trtmt,y=data_type,fill=Trtmt,label=sample_size))+
    geom_tile()+
    geom_text()+
    theme_classic2()+
    scale_fill_manual(values=trtmt_col)+
    theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          text=element_text(face="bold"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust=.5,size=12))+
    ggtitle("Sample size")

ggsave("results/figures/supp/pd_smry.png",pdsmry,height = 2.5,width = 4)
```

### Soil chemistry

```{r}
# Soil Nitrogen
N <- ggplot(soil_chi,aes(x=trmt,y=N_mg/Mass, color=trmt))+ 
  geom_point(size=3,alpha=.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#ffe1b0","#6b5e49","#0f0d0a"), labels=c("Poor","Intermediate","Rich"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  labs(color="Soils (n=3)",
       y=bquote(bold("Nitrogen (mg.mg "[DM]~")")),
       x="")+
    theme(text = element_text(face="bold"))

# Soil Carbon
C <- ggplot(soil_chi,aes(x=trmt,y=C_mg/Mass, color=trmt))+ 
  geom_point(size=3,alpha=.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#ffe1b0","#6b5e49","#0f0d0a"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  labs(color="Soil treatments",
       y=bquote(bold("Carbon (mg.mg "[DM]~")")),
       x="")+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        text = element_text(face="bold"))

# Soil Phosphorus
P <- ggplot(soil_chi,aes(x=trmt,y=P_mgkg/1000, color=trmt))+
  geom_point(size=3,alpha=.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#ffe1b0","#6b5e49","#0f0d0a"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  labs(color="Soil treatments",
       y=bquote(bold("Phosphorus (mg.mg "[DM]~")")),
       x="")+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        text = element_text(face="bold"))

leg <- ggpubr::get_legend(N) #Extract legend

soil_chi_plot <- (C|N+theme(legend.position="none"))/(P|leg)
ggsave("results/figures/supp/soil_chi.png",soil_chi_plot, device="png",height = 5,width=5)
```

```{r}
#PCA biplot
plot_pca<- factoextra::fviz_pca_biplot(PCA_plant_trait,

        legend.title = element_text(size=22),
        legend.text = element_text(size=20), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        title = element_blank(),
        text=element_text(face="bold"))

ggsave(plot=plot_pca,
```

```{r}
# Plot variable contribution to 2 first components and correlogram with farther components
rownames(PCA_plant_trait$var$coord) <- trait_df_name$cleannames[match(rownames(PCA_plant_trait$var$coord),trait_df_name$rawnames)] # set rownames as clean variable names

# on dim1
contrib_dim1 <- factoextra::fviz_contrib(PCA_plant_trait,'var',fill='lightgrey',color='grey28')+
  theme_classic2()+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  labs(x="")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,margin=margin(t=3),hjust=1,vjust=1))+
  ggtitle("First dimension")
# on dim2
contrib_dim2 <- factoextra::fviz_contrib(PCA_plant_trait,'var',fill='lightgrey',color='grey28',axes=2)+
  theme_classic2()+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  labs(x="")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,margin=margin(t=3),hjust=1,vjust=1))+
  ggtitle("Second dimension")
# combine
contrib_var <- contrib_dim1/contrib_dim2

# correlogram

                                                                     trait_df_name$rawnames)]
```

###POV PCA

```{r}


pov_list2 <- NULL #to store
for(traits in colnames(PCA_plant_trait$ind$coord[,1:3])){ #for all traits
    
    data_temp <- data.frame(trait=PCA_plant_trait$ind$coord[,traits], drought=data_leaf$drought,substrate=data_leaf$substrate) # add treatment info
    pov_list2[[traits]] <- POV::POV(trait~drought+substrate,data_temp) # variance partitioning
}
pov_list2 %<>% # transform to ggplot compatible dataframe
    purrr::map(~mutate(.,var_source=rownames(.)))%>%
    purrr::map(~reshape2::melt(.))
pov_merged2 <- bind_rows(pov_list2, .id = "trait") # merge into one dataframe




new_pov2 <- pov_merged2%>% # rename variable and order factors
    filter(variable=='% of total')%>%
    arrange(value)%>%
    mutate(var_source=as.factor(var_source),
           rawnames=as.factor(trait))%>%
    mutate(var_source=forcats::fct_relevel(var_source,
                                           "Common",
                                           "Between drought",
                                           "Between substrate",
                                           "Within drought",
                                           "Within substrate"))

var_order_common2 <- filter(new_pov2,var_source=="Common")%>%
    arrange(desc(value))%>%
    mutate(order_com=1:nrow(.))%>%
    dplyr::select(trait,order_com)
var_order_drought2 <- filter(new_pov2,var_source=="Between drought")%>%
    arrange(desc(value))%>%
    mutate(order_drought=1:nrow(.))%>%
    dplyr::select(trait,order_drought)
var_order_substrate2 <- filter(new_pov2,var_source=="Between substrate")%>%
    arrange(desc(value))%>%
    mutate(orde_sbustrater=1:nrow(.))%>%
    dplyr::select(trait,orde_sbustrater)

new_pov2 <- plyr::join_all(list(new_pov2,var_order_common2,var_order_drought2,var_order_substrate2),by="trait")


bar_traits_var2 <- new_pov2%>% #build the graph
    filter(trait!="Dim.3")%>%
    mutate(trait=gsub("Dim.","PCA ",trait))%>%
    mutate(var_source = forcats::fct_relevel(var_source,"Common", after = Inf ))%>% # reorder levels
    ggplot( aes(x=trait,y=value , fill= var_source)) + # plot
    geom_bar(position =position_stack(reverse=T),stat="identity")+
    scale_fill_manual(values=paletteer::paletteer_d("nationalparkcolors::Acadia"), name="")+
    theme_classic2()+
    xlab("")+
    ylab("% of variance")+ # theme
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=5),hjust=1))+
    scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          legend.margin=margin(c(1,1,1,1)),
          legend.box.margin=margin(1,1,1,1),
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
          legend.text = element_text(size=8),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "mm"),
          legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "mm"),
          text = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("results/figures/supp/POV_pca_dim.pdf",bar_traits_var2,height = 4,width = 5)
```


### POV traits

```{r}
# Traits partition of variance
pov_list <- NULL #to store
for(traits in trait_df_name$rawnames[-14]){ #for all traits
  col <- data_leaf[,match(traits,colnames(data_leaf))] # get the trait values
  data_temp <- data.frame(trait=col, drought=data_leaf$drought,substrate=data_leaf$substrate) # add treatment info
  pov_list[[traits]] <- POV::POV(trait~drought+substrate,data_temp) # variance partitioning
}
pov_list %<>% # transform to ggplot compatible dataframe
  purrr::map(~mutate(.,var_source=rownames(.)))%>%
  purrr::map(~reshape2::melt(.))

pov_merged <- bind_rows(pov_list, .id = "trait") # merge into one dataframe

new_pov <- pov_merged%>% # rename variable and order factors
  filter(variable=='% of total')%>%
  arrange(value)%>%
  mutate(var_source=as.factor(var_source),
         rawnames=as.factor(trait))%>%
  mutate(var_source=forcats::fct_relevel(var_source,
                                         "Common",
                                         "Between drought",
                                         "Between substrate",
                                         "Within drought",
                                         "Within substrate"))

var_order_common <- filter(new_pov,var_source=="Common")%>%
  arrange(desc(value))%>%
  mutate(order_com=1:nrow(.))%>%
  dplyr::select(trait,order_com)
var_order_drought <- filter(new_pov,var_source=="Between drought")%>%
  arrange(desc(value))%>%
  mutate(order_drought=1:nrow(.))%>%
  dplyr::select(trait,order_drought)
var_order_substrate <- filter(new_pov,var_source=="Between substrate")%>%
  arrange(desc(value))%>%
  mutate(orde_sbustrater=1:nrow(.))%>%
  dplyr::select(trait,orde_sbustrater)

new_pov <- plyr::join_all(list(new_pov,var_order_common,var_order_drought,var_order_substrate),by="trait")
new_pov <- left_join(new_pov,trait_df_name)


bar_traits_var <- new_pov%>% #build the graph
  mutate(cleannames = forcats::fct_reorder(cleannames,var_cat))%>% # reorder levels
  mutate(var_source = forcats::fct_relevel(var_source,"Common", after = Inf ))%>% # reorder levels
  ggplot( aes(x=cleannames,y=value , fill= var_source)) + # plot
  geom_bar(position =position_stack(reverse=T),stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_manual(values=paletteer::paletteer_d("nationalparkcolors::Acadia"), name="")+
  theme_classic2()+
  xlab("")+
  ylab("% of variance")+ # theme
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(margin=margin(t=5),hjust=1))+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.justification = c("left"),
        legend.box.just = "left",
        legend.margin=margin(c(1,1,1,1)),
        legend.box.margin=margin(1,1,1,1),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "mm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "mm"))+
    coord_flip()

bar_trait <- (bar_traits_var+theme(axis.text = element_text(face="bold"), # transform to bold text
                                   axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold"),
                                   legend.text = element_text(face='bold')) | 
                  trait_df_name%>% # add variable categories color
                  mutate(cleannames = forcats::fct_reorder(cleannames,var_cat))%>%
                  mutate(var_cat = forcats::fct_relevel(var_cat,
                                                        c("biomass",'nutrient','photosynthesis','structural','water','reproduction')))%>%
                  ggplot(aes(x=1,y=cleannames,fill=var_cat))+
                  geom_tile()+
                  theme_void()+
                  scale_fill_manual(values = var_cat_col, 
                                    name="Variable categories")+
                  theme(legend.text = element_text(face="bold"),
                        legend.title = element_text(face='bold')))+
    plot_layout(widths = c(15,1))
```

```{r}
pdens <- NULL
for(i in Nbcol){ # for all variable in Nbcol

    plot <- local({

            geom_boxplot()+
            scale_fill_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments")+

                  axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold",color=arrange(trait_df_name,var_cat)[which(arrange(trait_df_name,var_cat)$rawnames==names(data_leaf)[i]),"colorz"]), # color X title according to variable category
                  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.y = element_blank())})
    pdens[[names(data_leaf)[i]]] <- plot
}
```

####Alpha-div ~ Flowers
```{r}
flower_richness_list <- NULL
for (i in datasets){
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  trtmt <- data_tmp$sample_table$Trtmt
  Flowers <- data_tmp$sample_table$Flowers
  sr <- hillR::hill_taxa(t(data_tmp$otu_table), q = 0, MARGIN = 1, base = exp(1))
  shan <- hillR::hill_taxa(t(data_tmp$otu_table), q = 1, MARGIN = 1, base = exp(1))
  invsimp <- hillR::hill_taxa(t(data_tmp$otu_table), q = 2, MARGIN = 1, base = exp(1))
  
  data_tmp$sample_table$sr <- sr
  data_tmp$sample_table$shan <- shan
  data_tmp$sample_table$invsimp <- invsimp
  
  assign(i,data_tmp)
  
  lm_outs <- summary(lm(cbind(sr,shan,invsimp)~Flowers))
  
  flower_richness_list[[i]]$sr <- data_tmp$sample_table%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Flowers,y=sr,color=Trtmt))+
    geom_point()+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col)+
    theme_classic2()+
    ylab(paste0("Observed ",ifelse(grepl("16",i),"bacterial","fungal")," OTUs richness"))+
    xlab("")+
    labs(color="Treatment")+
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.7, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=14),
          legend.text = element_text(size=12))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2,
                              title.hjust=0.5))+
    {if(lm_outs[[1]]$coefficients[2,4]<0.05)geom_smooth(method="lm",color="black")}+
    annotate(geom = "text",
             label=paste0("pval: ",
                          round(lm_outs[[1]]$coefficients[2,4],digits=3),
                          collapse = "\n"),
             x=min(Flowers)+(max(Flowers)-min(Flowers))*0.05,
             y=max(sr)+(max(sr)-min(sr))*0.2,
             hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,fontface=2)+
    annotate(geom="text",
             label=as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[1]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 3))))),
             x=min(Flowers)+(max(Flowers)-min(Flowers))*0.05,
             y=max(sr)+(max(sr)-min(sr))*0.15,
             hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,parse=T)
  
flower_richness_list[[i]]$shan <- data_tmp$sample_table%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Flowers,y=shan,color=Trtmt))+
    geom_point()+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col)+
    theme_classic2()+
    ylab(paste0(ifelse(grepl("16",i),"Bacterial","Fungal")," Shannon entropy"))+
    xlab("")+
    labs(color="Treatment")+
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.7, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=14),
          legend.text = element_text(size=12))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2,
                              title.hjust=0.5))+
    {if(lm_outs[[2]]$coefficients[2,4]<0.05)geom_smooth(method="lm",color="black")}+
    annotate(geom = "text",
             label=paste0("pval: ",
                          round(lm_outs[[2]]$coefficients[2,4],digits=3),
                          collapse = "\n"),
             x=min(Flowers)+(max(Flowers)-min(Flowers))*0.05,
             y=max(shan)+(max(shan)-min(shan))*0.2,
             hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,fontface=2)+
    annotate(geom="text",
             label=as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[2]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 3))))),
             x=min(Flowers)+(max(Flowers)-min(Flowers))*0.05,
             y=max(shan)+(max(shan)-min(shan))*0.15,
             hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,parse=T)



flower_richness_list[[i]]$invsimp <- data_tmp$sample_table%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Flowers,y=invsimp,color=Trtmt))+
    geom_point()+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col)+
    theme_classic2()+
    ylab(paste0(ifelse(grepl("16",i),"Bacterial","Fungal")," inverse Simpson index"))+

    labs(color="Treatment")+
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(1.7, 'cm'),

             x=min(Flowers)+(max(Flowers)-min(Flowers))*0.05,
             y=max(invsimp)+(max(invsimp)-min(invsimp))*0.2,
             hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,fontface=2)+

             label=as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[1]), digits = 2),
```

##3) Anna Karenina principle

###Beta diversity

#### Data transformation

Hellinger transformation
```{r}
for(i in datasets){
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp) # break link between data_tmp and og file
  data_tmp$tidy_dataset()
  data_tmp$otu_table <- t(labdsv::hellinger(t(data_tmp$otu_table)))
  data_tmp$sample_table %<>% mutate(nb_reads = colSums(data_tmp$otu_table),
                               nb_motus = colSums(data_tmp$otu_table>0))
  assign(paste0(i,"_hell"),data_tmp) 
}
```

#### Rolling windows

#####Flowers
```{r}
list_beta_droll <- list()
list_beta_proll <- list()
for(i in datasets){
    dtmp_hell <- get(paste0(i,"_hell"))
    dtmp_hell <- clone(dtmp_hell)
    dtmp_hell$sample_table %<>% 
      arrange(Flowers,Pl_H)
    dtmp_hell$otu_table <- dtmp_hell$otu_table[,dtmp_hell$sample_table$sample_id] 
rollwin <- CommEcol::betaRegDisp(t(dtmp_hell$otu_table),dtmp_hell$sample_table$Flowers,ws=round(0.05*nrow(dtmp_hell$sample_table)),method.1 = "horn")
rollwin <- as.data.frame(rollwin)
rollwin$sample_id <- dtmp_hell$sample_table$sample_id[1:(length(dtmp_hell$sample_table$sample_id)-round(0.05*nrow(dtmp_hell$sample_table))+1)]
rollwin %<>%
  left_join(dtmp_hell$sample_table)


  lm_eqn <- function(df){
    m <- lm(mean.diss.focal ~ Flowers, rollwin);
    eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
                     list(a = format(unname(coef(m)[1]), digits = 2),
                          b = format(unname(coef(m)[2]), digits = 2),
                          r2 = format(summary(m)$r.squared, digits = 3)))
    as.character(as.expression(eq));
  }
mean.diss.focal <- rollwin$mean.diss.focal
grad <- rollwin$grad

list_beta_droll[[i]] <- rollwin
list_beta_proll[[i]] <- rollwin %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=grad,y=mean.diss.focal,colour = Trtmt))+
    geom_point()+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col)+
    theme_classic2()+
    xlab("Flowers")+
    ylab("Rolling window mean Morisita-Horn distance")+
    labs(color="Treatment")+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"),
          legend.key.size = unit(1.7, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_text(size=14),
          legend.text = element_text(size=12))+
    guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2,
                              title.hjust=0.5))+
    {if(!gtools::stars.pval(summary(lm(data=rollwin,mean.diss.focal~ grad))$coefficients[2,4])%in%c("."," "))geom_smooth(method="lm",color="black")}+
    annotate(geom = "text",label=paste0("pval: ",ifelse(gtools::stars.pval(summary(lm(data=rollwin,mean.diss.focal~ grad))$coefficients[2,4])%in%c("."," "),"NS",                                      gtools::stars.pval(summary(lm(data=rollwin,mean.diss.focal~ grad))$coefficients[2,4])),
                                        collapse = "\n"),
             x=min(grad)+(max(grad)-min(grad))*0.05,y=max(mean.diss.focal)+(max(mean.diss.focal)-min(mean.diss.focal))*0.2,hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,fontface=2)+
    annotate(geom="text",label=lm_eqn(rollwin),x=min(grad)+(max(grad)-min(grad))*0.05,y=max(mean.diss.focal)+(max(mean.diss.focal)-min(mean.diss.focal))*0.15,hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,parse=T)+
  ggtitle(ifelse(grepl("16s",i),"Bacteria","Fungi"))
  
print(paste0(i,",ws=",round(0.05*nrow(dtmp_hell$sample_table))))
}
```

#####PCA Dim1

```{r}
list_beta_droll_pca1 <- list()
list_beta_proll_pca1 <- list()
for(i in datasets){
    dtmp_hell <- get(paste0(i,"_hell"))
    dtmp_hell <- clone(dtmp_hell)
    # dtmp_hell$sample_table %<>% 
    #     arrange(Flowers,Pl_H)
    
    df_pca <- data.frame(PCA_plant_trait$ind$coord)
    df_pca$ID <- data_leaf$ID
    df_pca %<>%
        select(ID, Dim.1,Dim.2)
    
    dtmp_hell$sample_table %<>%
        left_join(df_pca)
    
    dtmp_hell$sample_table %<>%
        arrange(Dim.1)
    
    dtmp_hell$otu_table <- dtmp_hell$otu_table[,dtmp_hell$sample_table$sample_id] 
    rollwin <- CommEcol::betaRegDisp(t(dtmp_hell$otu_table),dtmp_hell$sample_table$Dim.1,ws=round(0.05*nrow(dtmp_hell$sample_table)),method.1 = "horn")
    rollwin <- as.data.frame(rollwin)
    rollwin$sample_id <- dtmp_hell$sample_table$sample_id[1:(length(dtmp_hell$sample_table$sample_id)-round(0.05*nrow(dtmp_hell$sample_table))+1)]
    rollwin %<>%
        left_join(dtmp_hell$sample_table)
    
    
    lm_eqn <- function(df){
        m <- lm(mean.diss.focal ~ Dim.1, rollwin);
        eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
                         list(a = format(unname(coef(m)[1]), digits = 2),
                              b = format(unname(coef(m)[2]), digits = 2),
                              r2 = format(summary(m)$r.squared, digits = 3)))
        as.character(as.expression(eq));
    }
    mean.diss.focal <- rollwin$mean.diss.focal
    grad <- rollwin$grad
    
    list_beta_droll_pca1[[i]] <- rollwin
    list_beta_proll_pca1[[i]] <- 
        rollwin %>%
        ggplot(aes(x=grad,y=mean.diss.focal,colour = Trtmt))+
        geom_point()+
        scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col)+
        theme_classic2()+
        xlab("Dim.1")+
        ylab("Rolling window mean Morisita-Horn distance")+
        labs(color="Treatment")+
        theme(text=element_text(face="bold"),
              legend.key.size = unit(1.7, 'cm'),
              legend.title = element_text(size=14),
              legend.text = element_text(size=12))+
        guides(color=guide_legend(ncol=2,
                                  title.hjust=0.5))+
        {if(!gtools::stars.pval(summary(lm(data=rollwin,mean.diss.focal~ grad))$coefficients[2,4])%in%c("."," "))geom_smooth(method="lm",color="black")}+
        annotate(geom = "text",label=paste0("pval: ",ifelse(gtools::stars.pval(summary(lm(data=rollwin,mean.diss.focal~ grad))$coefficients[2,4])%in%c("."," "),"NS",                                      gtools::stars.pval(summary(lm(data=rollwin,mean.diss.focal~ grad))$coefficients[2,4])),
                                            collapse = "\n"),
                 x=min(grad)+(max(grad)-min(grad))*0.05,y=max(mean.diss.focal)+(max(mean.diss.focal)-min(mean.diss.focal))*0.2,hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,fontface=2)+
        annotate(geom="text",label=lm_eqn(rollwin),x=min(grad)+(max(grad)-min(grad))*0.05,y=max(mean.diss.focal)+(max(mean.diss.focal)-min(mean.diss.focal))*0.15,hjust="left",vjust="Top",size=3,parse=T)+
        ggtitle(ifelse(grepl("16s",i),"Bacteria","Fungi"))
    
    print(paste0(i,",ws=",round(0.05*nrow(dtmp_hell$sample_table))))
}
```

#### Upset plots

```{r}
upset_list <- NULL
uplist <- NULL
for(i in datasets){
    data_tmp <- get(i)
    data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp)
    
    merged_tmp <-  data_tmp$merge_samples(group = "Trtmt")
    t1 <- trans_venn$new(dataset = merged_tmp)
    t1$res_names <- t1$res_names[c(4,5,6,3,2,1)]
    
    self <- t1
    colnumber <- self$colnumber
    ratio <- self$ratio
    res_names <- self$res_names
    switch_num <- colnumber - 1
    summary_table <- self$data_summary
    name_joint <- self$name_joint
    samplesum <- self$data_samplesum
    
    sample_levels <- res_names %>% rev
    plot_data <- summary_table %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>% .[order(.$Counts, 
                                                                  decreasing = TRUE), ]
    upset_list[[i]] <- plot_data
    
    plot_data_complete <- t1$data_details
    
    plot_data_complete%<>%
        mutate(dumb=paste0("row_",rownames(.)))%>%
        reshape2::melt("dumb")%>%
        mutate(label=gsub("^M","",value))
    
    
    tot_counts <- plot_data$Counts%>%sum
    tot_ab <- plot_data$Abundance%>%sum
    most_ab <- max(plot_data$Abundance)
    plot_data%<>%
        filter(Counts!=0)%>%
        mutate(rowname=factor(rowname,levels=rowname))
    
    plot_data_complete%<>%
        mutate(variable=as.factor(variable))%>%
        mutate(variable=forcats::fct_relevel(variable,levels(plot_data$rowname)))%>%
        left_join(dplyr::rename(plot_data,variable=rowname))
    
    
    plot_data %<>%
        dplyr::slice(1:7)%>%
        mutate(rowname=factor(rowname,levels=rowname))
    
    plot_data$rowname <- droplevels(plot_data$rowname)
                
    plot_data_complete %<>%
        filter(variable%in%plot_data$rowname)%>%
        filter(value!="")
                
    plot_data_complete$variable <- droplevels(plot_data_complete$variable)
    
    g1_grp <- plot_data_complete%>%
        group_by(variable)%>%
        summarise(Counts=n())%>%
        ggplot(aes(x = variable, y = Counts)) + 
        theme_classic() + 
        geom_bar(stat = "identity",position="stack",width=.5,fill="grey") + 
        ylab("Intersection size") + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
                                          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                          axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) + 
        theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 9), 
              axis.title = element_text(size = 12))+
        theme( axis.text = element_text(face="bold"),
               axis.title = element_text(face="bold"))
    
            matrix_data <- matrix(nrow = colnumber, ncol = nrow(plot_data)) %>% 
                as.data.frame
            rownames(matrix_data) <- sample_levels
            colnames(matrix_data) <- plot_data[, 1]
            for (cc in colnames(matrix_data)) {
                tmp <- strsplit(cc, name_joint, fixed = TRUE) %>% unlist
                for (j in rownames(matrix_data)) {
                    if (j %in% tmp) {
                        matrix_data[j, cc] <- 1
                    }
                }
            }
            sample_long <- matrix_data %>% tibble::rownames_to_column() %>% reshape2::melt(., 
                                                                                 id.vars = "rowname")
            sample_long$variable %<>% factor(., levels = levels(plot_data[, 
                                                                          1]))
            sample_long$rowname %<>% factor(levels = sample_levels)
            sample_ture <- sample_long[!is.na(sample_long$value), ]
            sample_all <- sample_long
            sample_all$value <- 1
            g2 <- ggplot(sample_long, aes(x = variable, y = rowname))
            for (cc in seq_len(length(unique(sample_ture$rowname)))) {
                if (cc%%2 == 1) {
                    g2 <- g2 + geom_rect(ymin = cc - 0.5, ymax = cc + 
                                             0.5, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, fill = "grey", 
                                         colour =  "grey")
                }
                else {
                    g2 <- g2 + geom_rect(ymin = cc - 0.5, ymax = cc + 
                                             0.5, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, fill = "azure2", 
                                         colour = "azure2")
                }
            }
            g2 <- g2 + geom_point(aes(x = variable, y = rowname), data = sample_all, 
                                  size = 3, color = "white", inherit.aes = FALSE) + 
                geom_point(aes(x = variable, y = rowname), data = sample_ture, 
                           size = 3, color = "black", 
                           inherit.aes = FALSE) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none") + 
                theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
                      axis.ticks = element_blank()) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10)) + 
                theme(panel.border = element_blank()) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
            line_data <- matrix_data
            line_data[] <- lapply(line_data, function(x) {
                x <- 1:length(x)
                x
            })
            line_data[is.na(matrix_data)] <- NA
            line_data2 <- data.frame(y = apply(line_data, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                     yend = apply(line_data, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE), x = 1:ncol(line_data), 
                                     xend = 1:ncol(line_data))
            g2 <- g2 + geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), 
                                    data = line_data2,
                                    color="black")+
                theme(axis.text = element_text(face="bold"),
                      axis.title = element_text(face="bold"))
            
            g3_data <- data.frame(number = samplesum, rowname = names(samplesum))
            g3_data$rowname %<>% factor(levels = sample_levels)
            g3 <- ggplot(g3_data, aes(x = number, y = rowname))
            for (cc in seq_len(length(unique(g3_data$rowname)))) {
                if (cc%%2 == 1) {
                    g3 <- g3 + geom_rect(ymin = cc - 0.5, ymax = cc + 
                                             0.5, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, fill = "lightgrey", 
                                         colour = "lightgrey")
                }
                else {
                    g3 <- g3 + geom_rect(ymin = cc - 0.5, ymax = cc + 
                                             0.5, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, fill = "azure2", 
                                         colour = "azure2")
                }
            }
            g3 <- g3 + geom_col(aes(color=rowname,fill=rowname)) + 
                scale_fill_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments")+
                scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments")+
                theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_x_reverse(expand=c(0,10)) + 
                theme(axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
                      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) + theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8)) + 
                theme(panel.border = element_blank()) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())+
                theme(axis.text = element_text(face="bold"),
                      axis.title = element_text(face="bold"))
            
            zz <- data_tmp$otu_table%>%mutate(otus=rownames(.))%>%reshape2::melt()%>%filter(value!=0)%>%group_by(variable)%>%mutate(relab_sample=(value/sum(value))*100)
            
            list_relab <- NULL
            for(j in 1:ncol(t1$data_details)){
                
                tmp_relab <- data_tmp$otu_table%>%
                    mutate(otus=rownames(.))%>%
                    reshape2::melt(id.var="otus")%>%
                    mutate(combination=colnames(t1$data_details)[j])%>%
                    mutate(combination_status=ifelse(otus%in%t1$data_details[,j],"isin","notin"))
                
                list_relab  <- rbind(list_relab,tmp_relab)
            }
            
            list_relab%<>%
                left_join(zz)%>%
                filter(value!=0)
            
            plot_data %<>% mutate(cumab=cumsum(Abundance))
            plot_data%<>%mutate(intersect=rowname)
            plot_data%<>%mutate(cumrelab=(cumab/most_ab)*100)
            plot_data%<>%mutate(relab=(Abundance/tot_ab)*100)
            
            bxupset <- list_relab %>%
                filter(combination_status!="notin")%>%
                filter(combination%in%plot_data$rowname)%>%
                mutate(combination=forcats::fct_relevel(combination,levels(plot_data$rowname)))%>%
                ggplot(aes(x=combination,y=relab_sample))+
                geom_boxplot(fill="grey")+
                theme_classic2()+
                theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                      axis.ticks.x = element_blank())+
                scale_y_log10(breaks = c(.5,1,5,10,20,40,60))+  #trans_breaks(identity, identity, n = 6)
                ylab("Relative abundance (%)")+ 
                theme(axis.text = element_text(face="bold"),
                      axis.title = element_text(face="bold")) 
            
            
            layout <- "
#BBB
ACCC
#DDD
"
            up2save <- g3+theme(axis.title = element_blank())+g1_grp+scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+g2+theme(axis.title = element_blank())+bxupset+plot_layout(design = layout,heights = c(.1,.1,.12),widths = c(.3,.6))&theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))
            uplist[[i]] <- up2save

}
```

####Prevalence group relab
```{r}
prev_relab <- list()
prev_relab_flowers <- list()
prev_relab_pca1 <- list()
for(i in datasets){
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp)
  
  df_pca <- data.frame(PCA_plant_trait$ind$coord)
  df_pca$ID <- data_leaf$ID
  df_pca %<>%
      select(ID, Dim.1,Dim.2)
  
  data_tmp$sample_table %<>%
      left_join(df_pca)
  
  data_tmp$sample_table %<>%
      arrange(Dim.1)
  
  df <-  data_tmp$otu_table%>%
    mutate(label=gsub("M","",rownames(.)))%>%
    reshape2::melt()%>%
    group_by(label)%>%
    dplyr::rename(sample_id=variable)%>%
    mutate(prev=sum(value>0))%>%
    mutate(prev_cat=ifelse(prev<0.05*nrow(data_tmp$sample_table),
                           "5%<.",
                           ifelse(prev>.8*nrow(data_tmp$sample_table),
                                  ".>80%",
                                  "5%<.<80%")))%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(prev_cat=forcats::fct_relevel(prev_cat,".>80%","5%<.<80%","5%<."))%>%
    left_join(data_tmp$sample_table)%>%
    group_by(sample_id,prev_cat)%>%
    summarise(relab=sum(value/nb_reads),
              Flowers=unique(Flowers),
              Dim.1=unique(Dim.1))%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(sample_id=forcats::fct_relevel(sample_id,levels(data_tmp$sample_table$sample_id)))
  
  
  prev_relab[[i]] <- df %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=sample_id,y=relab*100,fill=prev_cat))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity",width=1)+
    theme_classic2()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank())+
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0,0)))+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkorange","darkorchid4","cornflowerblue"),name="OTUs prevalence")+
    ylab("Cumulative relative abundance (%)")+
    ggtitle(ifelse(grepl("16s",i),"Bacteria","Fungi"))
  
  
  lm_outs <- summary(lm(cbind(`.>80%`,`5%<.`,`5%<.<80%`)*100~Flowers, tidyr::pivot_wider(df,names_from = prev_cat,values_from = relab)))
  sig_prev_cat <- gsub("Response ","",names(lm_outs)[which(c(lm_outs[[1]]$coefficients[2,4],
                                                             lm_outs[[2]]$coefficients[2,4],
                                                             lm_outs[[3]]$coefficients[2,4])<0.05)])
 
  
  df_text <- data.frame(prev_cat=gsub("Response ","",names(lm_outs)),
                        label=c(as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2~" | pval ="~pval, 
                                                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[1]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 2),
                                                                           pval = format(ifelse(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[8])>0.05,
                                                                                                "NS",
                                                                                                round(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[8]),digits=3))))))),
                                as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2~" | pval ="~pval, 
                                                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[2]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 2),
                                                                           pval = format(ifelse(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[8])>0.05,
                                                                                                "NS",
                                                                                                round(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[8]),digits=3))))))),
                                as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2~" | pval ="~pval, 
                                                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[3]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 2),
                                                                           pval = format(ifelse(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[8])>0.05,
                                                                                                "NS",
                                                                                                round(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[8]),digits=3)))))))),
                        x=c(10,10,10),
                        y=c(90,95,100))
  
  
  prev_relab_flowers[[i]] <- 
  df%>%
     # dplyr::filter(prev_cat!="5%<.<80%")%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Flowers,y=relab*100,color=prev_cat))+
    geom_point()+
    geom_smooth(data=subset(df,prev_cat%in%sig_prev_cat),show.legend = F,method="lm")+
    theme_classic2()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkorange","darkorchid4","cornflowerblue"),name="OTUs prevalence")+
    ylab("Cumulative relative abundance (%)")+
    xlab("Flowers")+
    ggtitle(ifelse(grepl("16s",i),"Bacteria","Fungi"))+

    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,100),expand = expansion(add=c(0,10)))+

  lm_outs <- summary(lm(cbind(`.>80%`,`5%<.`,`5%<.<80%`)*100~Dim.1, tidyr::pivot_wider(df,names_from = prev_cat,values_from = relab)))
  sig_prev_cat <- gsub("Response ","",names(lm_outs)[which(c(lm_outs[[1]]$coefficients[2,4],
                                                             lm_outs[[2]]$coefficients[2,4],
                                                             lm_outs[[3]]$coefficients[2,4])<0.05)])
 
  
  df_text <- data.frame(prev_cat=gsub("Response ","",names(lm_outs)),
                        label=c(as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2~" | pval ="~pval, 
                                                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[1]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 2),
                                                                           pval = format(ifelse(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[8])>0.05,
                                                                                                "NS",
                                                                                                round(unname(coef(lm_outs[[1]])[8]),digits=3))))))),
                                as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2~" | pval ="~pval, 
                                                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[2]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[2]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 2),

                                                                                                "NS",

                                as.character(as.expression(substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2~" | pval ="~pval, 
                                                                      list(a = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[1]), digits = 2),
                                                                           b = format(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[2]), digits = 2),
                                                                           r2 = format(lm_outs[[3]]["r.squared"]$r.squared, digits = 2),
                                                                           pval = format(ifelse(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[8])>0.05,
                                                                                                "NS",
                                                                                                round(unname(coef(lm_outs[[3]])[8]),digits=3)))))))),
                        x=c(-2,-2,-2),
                        y=c(90,95,100))
```

##5) Microbial communities

###Composition plot
```{r}
# create trans_abund object
comp_barplots <- NULL
for(i in datasets){ # for both datasets (its and 16s)
  tmp <- get(i) # get the data
  tmp <- clone(tmp)
  tmp$tax_table%<>%
    mutate(Genus=ifelse(is.na(Genus),"g__Not assigned",Genus),
           Class=ifelse(is.na(Class),"c__Not assigned",Class),
           Order=ifelse(is.na(Order),"o__Not assigned",Order),
           Family=ifelse(is.na(Family),"f__Not assigned",Family))
  
  trans_tmp <- trans_abund$new(dataset = tmp, taxrank = "Class", ntaxa = 12) # abundance @class level. The top 12 most abundant are kept, others are grouped
  p_class <- trans_tmp$plot_bar(others_color = "grey70",facet = "Trtmt", xtext_keep = FALSE, legend_text_italic = FALSE) # plot it
  
  trans_tmp <- trans_abund$new(dataset = tmp, taxrank = "Order", ntaxa = 12) # @order level
  p_order <- trans_tmp$plot_bar(others_color = "grey70",facet = "Trtmt", xtext_keep = FALSE, legend_text_italic = FALSE)
  
  trans_tmp <- trans_abund$new(dataset = tmp, taxrank = "Family", ntaxa = 12) # @family
  p_family <- trans_tmp$plot_bar(others_color = "grey70",facet = "Trtmt", xtext_keep = FALSE, legend_text_italic = FALSE)
  
  trans_tmp <- trans_abund$new(dataset = tmp, taxrank = "Genus", ntaxa = 12) # @genus
  p_genus <- trans_tmp$plot_bar(others_color = "grey70",facet = "Trtmt", xtext_keep = FALSE, legend_text_italic = FALSE)
  
  plot_comb <- (p_class|p_order)/(p_family|p_genus) # merge
  comp_barplots[[i]] <- plot_comb # store
  ggsave(paste0("results/figures/supp/relab_",i,".png"),plot_comb, device="png", width=15,height = 10) # save
}
```

```{r}
#check the hypothesis that dispersion is roughly the same between my groups in multivariate space
dis <- vegan::vegdist(t(micro_16s_hell$otu_table),method="horn") #we create a distance matrix between our individuals
mod <- vegan::betadisper(dis,micro_16s_hell$sample_table$Trtmt) #we calculate the multivarite dispersions i.e. average distance to centroids
anova(mod) #now we check that they are no difference between our groups i.e. our idnividuals have the same dispersion in the multivariate space

#p-value = 0.05119   non significative so our group dispersion is homogeneous between habitats
k = 1000
adon.res1 <- vegan::adonis2(t(micro_16s_hell$otu_table)~micro_16s_hell$sample_table$drought*micro_16s_hell$sample_table$substrate, perm = k, na.rm = T, method = "horn",p.adjust.methods="holm",by="terms" ) 
adon.res1%>%
    mutate(Term=c("drought","substrate","drought:substrate","Residual","Total"),.before =1) %>%
    rename(pval=`Pr(>F)`)%>%
    flextable::flextable()%>%
    flextable::bold(i=~`pval`<0.05,j=6)%>%
  flextable::save_as_image(path="results/stats/permanova_mubiota_16s.png")
```

```{r}
methods_dist <- c("horn","bray","jaccard")
pcoas_list <- NULL
pcoas_taxa_list <- NULL
ordi_list <- NULL
for(d in datasets){
  for(m in methods_dist){
    
    if(m=="horn"){
      dtmp <- get(paste0(d,"_hell"))}
    else{
      dtmp <- get(d)}
    dtmp <- clone(dtmp) #clone data
    orditmp <- phyloseq::ordinate(file2meco::meco2phyloseq(dtmp), "PCoA", m,binary=ifelse(m=="jaccard",TRUE,FALSE)) # run pcoa 
    
    pcoa_sites <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(file2meco::meco2phyloseq(dtmp), orditmp,type = "sites",axes = c(1,2),color = "Trtmt")
    pcoa_taxa <- phyloseq::plot_ordination(file2meco::meco2phyloseq(dtmp), orditmp,type = "taxa",axes = c(1,2),color="Phylum")
    
    orditmp$scores <- orditmp$vectors
    envfitted <- vegan::envfit(orditmp,
                        dtmp$sample_table[,c(trait_df_name$rawnames[-which(trait_df_name$rawnames=="C.N_leaf")])],
                        permutations=9999)
    
    ordi_list[[d]][[m]] <- orditmp
    
    expl1 <- orditmp$values$Relative_eig[1]*100
    expl2 <- orditmp$values$Relative_eig[2]*100
    
    en_coord_cont <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(envfitted, "vectors")) * ggvegan:::arrow_mul(vegan::scores(envfitted, "vectors"),orditmp$vectors)
    en_coord_cont%<>%
      mutate(rawnames=rownames(.))%>%
      left_join(trait_df_name)%>%
      left_join(data.frame(rawnames=rownames(envfitted$vectors$arrows),
                           r2=envfitted$vectors$r,
                           psign=envfitted$vectors$pvals))
    
    df <- pcoa_sites$data
    gg <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2)) + 
      geom_point(data = df, aes(colour = Trtmt,shape=Trtmt), size = 3, alpha = 1) + 
      scale_colour_manual(values = trtmt_col) + 
      labs(colour = "Treatment")+
      ylab(paste0("Dim2 (",round(expl2,2),"%)"))+
      xlab(paste0("Dim1 (",round(expl1,2),"%)"))+
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(17,17,17,19,19,19),name="Treatment")+
      ggConvexHull::geom_convexhull(df,mapping=aes(x=Axis.1,y=Axis.2,fill = Trtmt, colour = Trtmt),
                      alpha=0.2)+
      scale_fill_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatment")
    
    centro_df <- df%>%
      group_by(Trtmt)%>%
      summarise(centro_x=mean(Axis.1),
                centro_y=mean(Axis.2))
    
    
    df_taxa <- pcoa_taxa$data
    gg_taxa <- ggplot(data = df_taxa, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2)) + 
      geom_point(data = df_taxa, aes(colour = Phylum), size = 3, alpha = 1) + 
      ylab(paste0("Dim2 (",round(expl2,2),"%)"))+
      xlab(paste0("Dim1 (",round(expl1,2),"%)"))
    
    pcoas_taxa_list[[d]][[m]] <- gg_taxa
    
    for(all_traits_or_no in c("alltraits","notalltraits")){
      
      
      if(all_traits_or_no=="notalltraits"){
        en_coord_cont2 <- en_coord_cont%>%
          filter(psign<0.05)
      }else{
        en_coord_cont2 <- en_coord_cont
      }
      
      pcoas_list[[d]][[m]][[all_traits_or_no]] <- gg+
        geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = Axis.1, yend = Axis.2), 
                     data = en_coord_cont2, linewidth =1, colour = "grey65",arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2,"cm")),lty=ifelse(en_coord_cont2$psign<0.05,1,2)) +
        geom_point(centro_df,mapping=aes(x=centro_x,y=centro_y,color=Trtmt,shape=Trtmt),size=5)+
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = en_coord_cont2, aes(x = Axis.1, y = Axis.2), 
                                 fontface = "bold",label=en_coord_cont2$cleannames,color=en_coord_cont2$colorz) + 
        geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
        geom_hline(yintercept=0,lty=2)+
        theme_classic2()+
        theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
        ggtitle(ifelse(grepl("16s",d),"Bacterial communities","Fungal communities"))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
for(i in datasets){
    
    data_tmp <- get(i)
    data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp)
    
    pcz <- data.frame(PCA_plant_trait$ind$coord)
    pcz %<>%
        mutate(variable=data_leaf$number)%>%
        mutate(variable=ifelse(nchar(variable)<2,paste0("0",variable),variable))
    
    pcz <- pcz[which(pcz$variable%in% gsub("_.*$","",colnames(data_tmp$otu_table))),]
    pcz <- data.frame(pcz)
    pcz %<>%
        dplyr::select(c(variable,"Dim.1","Dim.2","Dim.3"))
    
    # otu_data_tmp <- compositions::clr(t(data_tmp$otu_table)) #[which(rowSums(data_tmp$otu_table>0)>0.05*ncol(data_tmp$otu_table)),]
    otu_data_tmp <- t(data_tmp$otu_table)
    
    vp_tmp <- vegan::varpart(otu_data_tmp,pcz$Dim.1,pcz$Dim.2,pcz$Dim.3)
    
    otu_dis <- vegan::vegdist(labdsv::hellinger(t(data_tmp$otu_table)),method="horn")
    trait_dis <- vegan::vegdist(pcz[,-1],method="euclidean")

    mantel_traits <- vegan::mantel(otu_dis, trait_dis, method = "spearman", permutations = 999, na.rm = TRUE)
    
}
```

```{r}
alpha_glob_l <- list()
alpha_margin_l <- list()
for(i in datasets){
    
    for(bootstrap in 1:100){ #bootstrap
        
        anova_glob_tmp <- anova(dbrda_mod_list[[i]])
        anova_margin_tmp <- anova(dbrda_mod_list[[i]],by="margin") #marginal effect of each trait
        
        alpha_glob_l[[i]] <- c(alpha_glob_l[[i]],anova_glob_tmp$`Pr(>F)`[1])
        
        alpha_margin_l[[i]] <- anova_margin_tmp%>%
            data.frame() %>%
            mutate(iteration=bootstrap,
                   variable=rownames(.))%>%
            dplyr::rename(sos=SumOfSqs,
                          alpha=`Pr..F.`)%>%
            dplyr::select(-Df) %>%
            rbind(alpha_margin_l[[i]])
    }
}
```

```{r}
pdbrda_host_list <- list()
for(i in datasets){
  
  dbrda_mod <- dbrda_mod_list[[i]]
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  
  # get eigenvalue
  eig1_constrained <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[1]/sum(dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))*100,digits=2)
  eig2_constrained <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[2]/sum(dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))*100,digits=2)
  eig1_glob <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[1]/(sum((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))+sum(dbrda_mod$CA$eig)))*100,digits=2)
  eig2_glob <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[2]/(sum((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))+sum(dbrda_mod$CA$eig)))*100,digits=2)
  
  # extract df for ggplot
  fort_dbrda<- fortify(dbrda_mod)
  
  # scale variable scores
  vars <- ggvegan:::get_dimension_names(fort_dbrda)
  df_dbrda <- fort_dbrda %>%
    left_join(dplyr::rename(data_tmp$sample_table,label=sample_id)) %>%
      filter(score%in%c("biplot","sites"))
  
  want <- df_dbrda$score=="biplot"
  
  mul <- ggvegan:::arrow_mul(df_dbrda[want, vars, drop = FALSE], 
                             df_dbrda[!want, vars, drop = FALSE])
  df_dbrda[want, vars] <- mul * df_dbrda[want, vars]
  
  # Plot
  
  dbrda_plot_tmp <- ggplot(fort_dbrda, aes(x = dbrda1, y = dbrda2))+
    geom_point(data = df_dbrda[which(df_dbrda$score=="sites"),],

                           color=stage(Flowers, after_scale = alpha(color, 1))),
               size=3)+
          scale_color_gradientn(colours=c("#9a133d","lightpink","#c2ceaa","#8bac54"))+ 
geom_segment(data = df_dbrda[which(df_dbrda$score=="biplot"),], # add arrows for variables
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend=dbrda1, yend=dbrda2),
                 lineend = "round",
                 linejoin = "round",
                 linewidth = .75,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "inches")),
                 colour = "grey65") +
    coord_fixed()+ # fix proportion between axis units
    geom_text(data = df_dbrda[which(df_dbrda$score=="biplot"),], # add variable names at the end of arrows
              aes(x = ifelse(dbrda1<0,dbrda1*1.01,dbrda1*1.01), # nudge a bit the coordinates so that they're not on the arrows
                  y = ifelse(dbrda2<0,dbrda2*1.01,dbrda2*1.01),
                  label = label),
              color= "grey65")+
    theme_classic()+
    xlab(paste0(names(df_dbrda[which(df_dbrda$score=="biplot"),])[3]," (",eig1_constrained,"%)"))+
    ylab(paste0(names(df_dbrda[which(df_dbrda$score=="biplot"),])[4]," (",eig2_constrained,"%)"))+
    guides(fill="none")  +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype = "dashed")+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype = "dashed")+
    ggtitle(paste0(ifelse(grepl("16s",i),"Bacteria - constrained: ","Fungi - constrained: "),round((summary(dbrda_mod_list[[i]])$constr.chi/summary(dbrda_mod_list[[i]])$tot.chi)*100,digits=2),"%"))+
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold"))+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))
  
  pdbrda_host_list[[i]] <- dbrda_plot_tmp
  
}
```

##7) Microbial Niches

###Create OTUs clusters
```{r}
df_dbrda_list <- list()
dfbp_list <- list()
for(i in datasets){ #datasets
  dtmp <- get(i)
  dtmp <- clone(dtmp)
  dtmp_hell <- get(paste0(i,"_hell"))
  dtmp_hell <- clone(dtmp_hell)
  
  dbrda_mod <- dbrda_mod_list[[i]]
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  
  # get eigenvalue
  eig1_constrained <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[1]/sum(dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))*100,digits=2)
  eig2_constrained <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[2]/sum(dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))*100,digits=2)
  eig1_glob <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[1]/(sum((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))+sum(dbrda_mod$CA$eig)))*100,digits=2)
  eig2_glob <- round((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig[2]/(sum((dbrda_mod$CCA$eig))+sum(dbrda_mod$CA$eig)))*100,digits=2)
  
  # extract df for ggplot
  sppscores(dbrda_mod) <- t(dtmp_hell$otu_table)
  fort_dbrda <- fortify(dbrda_mod)
  
  # scale variable scores
  vars <- ggvegan:::get_dimension_names(fort_dbrda)

  df_dbrda <- fort_dbrda %>%
    left_join(dplyr::rename(data_tmp$sample_table,label=sample_id))
  df_dbrda <- df_dbrda[df_dbrda$score%in%c("sites","biplot"),]
  want <- df_dbrda$score=="biplot"

  # Get species coordinates
  d_sp <- data.frame(dbrda_mod$CCA$v)
  names(d_sp) <- tolower(names(d_sp))
  d_sp %<>%
    mutate(label=gsub("^M","",rownames(.)))
  
  mul <- ggvegan:::arrow_mul(df_dbrda[want, vars, drop = FALSE],
                             d_sp[!want, vars, drop = FALSE])
  df_dbrda[want, vars] <- mul * df_dbrda[want, vars]
  
  # Add OTU info
  d_sp2 <- dtmp$otu_table %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    mutate(label=rownames(.))%>%
    reshape2::melt()%>%
    filter(value!=0)%>%
    mutate(sample_id=gsub("X","",variable))%>%
    left_join(data_tmp$sample_table[,c("sample_id","nb_reads")]) %>%
    mutate(value=value/nb_reads)%>%
    group_by(label)%>%
    summarise(prevalence=n(),
              relab=mean(value))%>% #all samples rarefied at data_tmp$sample_table$nb_reads
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(label=gsub("^M","",label))
  
  # Join
  d_sp%<>%
    left_join(d_sp2)
  
  # Partition on coordinates
  maxK <- 15
  rownames(d_sp) <- d_sp$label
  
  bp_tmp <-  NbClust::NbClust(d_sp[,c("dbrda1","dbrda2")],distance = "euclidean",method = "kmeans",min.nc = 2,max.nc = maxK)
  
  dfbp <-  bp_tmp$Best.partition%>%
    reshape2::melt()%>%
    mutate(label=rownames(.),
           value=paste0("clust_",value))%>%
    dplyr::rename(cluster=value)%>%
    left_join(d_sp)
  
  df_dbrda_list[[i]] <- df_dbrda
  dfbp_list[[i]] <- dfbp
  
}
```

###Hmap and taxonomy clusters
```{r}
plist_taxcluster <- list()
plist_clustertax <- list()
hmap_cluster <- list()
for(i in datasets){ #datasets
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp)
  
  # get color
  colors_dbrda <- switch (i,
                          "micro_16s" = col_bac,
                          "micro_its"= col_fun)
  
 # Remove clusters
  clust2remove <- switch (i,
                          "micro_16s" = 1,
                          "micro_its"=3)
    
  OTU_data <- pdbrda_taxa_list[[i]]$layers[[1]]$data %>%
    left_join(mutate(data_tmp$tax_table,label=gsub("M","",rownames(data_tmp$tax_table))))
  
  
  plist_taxcluster[[i]] <-   
    OTU_data %>%
    group_by(Order,cluster) %>%
    summarise(n=n()) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    group_by(Order) %>%
    mutate(tot_Order=sum(n))%>%
    group_by(Order,cluster) %>%
    mutate(pct=n/tot_Order) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    arrange(tot_Order) %>%
    mutate(Order=ifelse(Order=="o__","Unknown Order",gsub("o__","",Order))) %>%
    mutate(Order=forcats::fct_inorder(Order))%>%
    # filter(cluster!=paste0("clust_",clust2remove))%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=Order,x=pct*100,fill=cluster))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
    # scale_x_log10()+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_dbrda)+
    theme_classic2()+
    ylab("Order")+
    xlab("%")+
    ggtitle(ifelse(grepl("16s",i),"Bacteria","Fungi"))+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90,hjust = 1,vjust = 1))+
    
    OTU_data %>%
    group_by(Order,cluster) %>%
    summarise(n=n()) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    group_by(Order) %>%
    mutate(tot_Order=sum(n))%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    arrange(tot_Order) %>%
    mutate(Order=ifelse(Order=="o__","Unknown Order",gsub("o__","",Order))) %>%
    mutate(Order=forcats::fct_inorder(Order))%>%
    # filter(cluster!=paste0("clust_",clust2remove))%>%
    ggplot(aes(y=Order,x=n,fill=cluster))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity",position=position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single"))+
    scale_x_log10()+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_dbrda,guide="none")+
    theme_void()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"),
          axis.line.x = element_line(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
          axis.title.x = element_text())+
    xlab("Number of OTUs")+
    
    plot_layout(guides = "collect",width=c(.5,2))
  
  
    # get color
  colors_tax <- switch (i,
                          "micro_16s" = c(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))(8),"grey60","grey25"),
                          "micro_its"=c(colorRampPalette(paletteer::paletteer_d("ggthemes::Classic_Green_Orange_12") )(8),"grey60","grey25"))
  
  
plist_clustertax[[i]] <-
  OTU_data %>%
    group_by(cluster,Order) %>%
    summarise(nperOrder=n()) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    mutate(tot_cluster=sum(nperOrder))%>%
    mutate(pct=nperOrder/tot_cluster)%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    group_by(Order) %>%
    mutate(tot_Order=sum(nperOrder)) %>%
    arrange(tot_Order) %>%
    mutate(Order=ifelse(is.na(Order),"Unknown Order",gsub("o__","",Order))) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(Order=forcats::fct_inorder(Order))%>%
    mutate(Order_order=as.numeric(Order)) %>%
    mutate(Order=ifelse(Order_order<max(Order_order)-8,"Others",as.character.factor(Order)))%>%
    mutate(Order=forcats::fct_relevel(Order,"Others","Unknown Order",after=Inf))%>%
    group_by(cluster,Order) %>%
    summarise(nperOrder=sum(nperOrder),
              pct=sum(pct)*100,
              tot_cluster=unique(tot_cluster)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y=cluster,x=pct,fill=Order))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
    geom_text(aes(label=nperOrder),position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5))+
    theme_classic()+
    xlab("%")+
  ylab("")+
  scale_fill_manual(name="Order",values=colors_tax)+
  theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion())

    group_by(Order) %>%
    mutate(tot_Order=sum(n())) %>%
    arrange(tot_Order) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(Order=forcats::fct_inorder(Order))%>%
    mutate(Order_order=as.numeric(Order)) %>%
    mutate(Order=ifelse(Order_order<max(Order_order)-8,"Others",as.character.factor(Order)))%>%
    mutate(Order=forcats::fct_relevel(Order,"Others","Unknown Order",after=Inf))


hmap_cluster[[i]] <- 
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  ggplot(summarise(group_by(d,sample_id,cluster),sum_val=sum(value),nb_reads=unique(nb_reads)) %>%
    mutate(relab=(sum_val/nb_reads)*100),aes(x=sample_id,y=relab,fill=cluster))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",width=1)+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors_dbrda,name="Cluster",guide="none")+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(),
        axis.ticks.length.y = unit(.2,"line"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,5,0))+
  ylab("Rel-ab (%)")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,101),expand = expansion(add=c(0,0)))+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=1,y=label,fill=cluster))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors_dbrda,name="Cluster")+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=sample_id,y=label,fill=relab))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill="azure3"))+
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans="log",breaks=c(.01,.1,1,5,10,30,60,100),labels=format(c(.01,.1,1,5,10,30,60,100),scientific = F),name="Relative abundance (%)",limits=c(0.01,100))+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=1,y=label,fill=Order))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors_tax,name="Order")+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=1,y=label,fill=prevalence))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name="Prevalence",option = "magma")+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=sample_id,y=1,fill=Flowers))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#9a133d","lightpink","#c2ceaa","#8bac54"))+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=sample_id,y=1,fill=Pl_H))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours=c("#e8e79a","#8cbf9a","#477b95","#191f40"),name = "Plant height")+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  plot_spacer()+
  
  ggplot(d,aes(x=sample_id,y=1,fill=Trtmt))+
  geom_tile()+
  theme_void()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = trtmt_col,name="Treatments")+
  
  plot_spacer()+

  plot_layout(guides = "collect",widths = c(.1,1,.1,.1),heights = c(.2,1,.05,.05,.05))&theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))
```

###Relab clusters

```{r}
relab_clusters_list <- list()
plow_clusters <- list()
for(i in datasets){
  
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp)
  
  # get color
  colors_dbrda <- switch (i,
                          "micro_16s" = col_bac,
                          "micro_its"= col_fun)
  
  
  OTU_data <- pdbrda_taxa_list[[i]]$layers[[1]]$data %>%
    left_join(mutate(data_tmp$tax_table,label=gsub("M","",rownames(data_tmp$tax_table))))
  
  pdata <- data_tmp$otu_table %>%
    mutate(label=gsub("M","",rownames(.))) %>%
    reshape2::melt() %>%
    dplyr::rename(sample_id=variable) %>%
    left_join(data_tmp$sample_table) %>%
    mutate(relab=(value/nb_reads)*100) %>%
    
    left_join(OTU_data[,c("label","cluster","dbrda1","dbrda2")]) %>%
    group_by(sample_id,cluster) %>% 
    summarise(relab_clust=sum(relab),
              Flowers=mean(Flowers),
              Nmg=mean(Nmg),
              Pl_H=mean(Pl_H)) %>%
    ungroup()   %>%
    left_join(data_tmp$sample_table)%>%
    arrange(Flowers,Pl_H) %>%
    mutate(sample_id=forcats::fct_inorder(sample_id))
  
  p <- 
    pdata %>%
    ggplot(aes(y=sample_id,x=relab_clust,fill=cluster))+
    geom_bar(stat = "identity",width=1)+
    theme_void()+
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors_dbrda,name="Cluster",guide="none")+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"),
          axis.line.x = element_line(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
          axis.ticks.length.x = unit(.2,"line"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(),
          plot.margin = margin(1,10,1,10),
          axis.title.x.top = element_text(color="#649eff"),
          axis.text.x.top = element_text(color="#649eff"),
          legend.position = "none")+
    xlab("Relative abundance (%)")+
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                       sec.axis=sec_axis(~.*(max(pdata$Flowers)/100),name="Flowers"))+
    geom_point(data=unique(pdata[,c("sample_id","Flowers","cluster","Trtmt")]),aes(y=sample_id,x=Flowers/(max(Flowers)/100)),
               show.legend=F,
               alpha=1,
               fill="#649eff",
               color="black",
               shape=21,
               size=2)
  relab_clusters_list[[i]] <- p
  
  plow_clusters[[i]] <- pdata %>%
    filter(Flowers==0)%>%
    filter(grepl("Bac 4|Fung 1",cluster)) %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    mutate(is_high_lowfit=ifelse(relab_clust>10,"yes","no")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=is_high_lowfit,y=Leaves))+
    geom_boxplot(outliers = F)+
    geom_jitter(height = 0,width = .2,aes(color=Trtmt))+
    ggpubr::theme_classic2()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments",guide="none")+
    ylab("Leaves (cm)")+
    xlab(paste0("10% of reads belong to the ",ifelse(i=="micro_16s","Bac 4","Fung 1")," cluster"))+
    
    pdata %>%
    filter(Flowers==0)%>%
    filter(grepl("Bac 4|Fung 1",cluster)) %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    mutate(is_high_lowfit=ifelse(relab_clust>10,"yes","no")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=is_high_lowfit,y=Nmg))+
    geom_boxplot(outliers = F)+
    geom_jitter(height = 0,width = .2,aes(color=Trtmt))+
    ggpubr::theme_classic2()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments",guide="none")+
    ylab(bquote(bold("Nitrogen"~"(mg.g"^-1 ~ ")")))+
    xlab(paste0("10% of reads belong to the ",ifelse(i=="micro_16s","Bac 4","Fung 1")," cluster"))+
    
    pdata %>%
    filter(Flowers==0)%>%
    filter(grepl("Bac 4|Fung 1",cluster)) %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    mutate(is_high_lowfit=ifelse(relab_clust>10,"yes","no")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=is_high_lowfit,y=LL_H))+
    geom_boxplot(outliers = F)+
    geom_jitter(height = 0,width = .2,aes(color=Trtmt))+
    ggpubr::theme_classic2()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments",guide="none")+
    ylab("Leaf length (cm)")+
    xlab(paste0("10% of reads belong to the ",ifelse(i=="micro_16s","Bac 4","Fung 1")," cluster"))+
    
    pdata %>%
    filter(Flowers==0)%>%
    filter(grepl("Bac 4|Fung 1",cluster)) %>%
    group_by(sample_id) %>%
    mutate(is_high_lowfit=ifelse(relab_clust>10,"yes","no")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=is_high_lowfit,y=Pl_H))+
    geom_boxplot(outliers = F)+
    geom_jitter(height = 0,width = .2,aes(color=Trtmt))+
    ggpubr::theme_classic2()+
    theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
    scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col,name="Treatments",guide="none")+
    ylab("Plant height (cm)")+
    xlab(paste0("10% of reads belong to the ",ifelse(i=="micro_16s","Bac 4","Fung 1")," cluster"))+
    
    plot_layout(axes = "collect")+
    plot_annotation(title=ifelse(i=="micro_16s","Bacteria","Fungi"))
  
  
  ggsave(paste0("results/figures/main/clust_cumab_",i,".pdf"),width=3,height = 1)
}
```

```{r}
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F,aes(color=Trtmt))+
  geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1),alpha=.8,aes(color=Trtmt))+
  scale_color_manual(values=trtmt_col,guide="none")+
  ggpubr::theme_classic2()+
  ggstats::geom_stripped_cols()+
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(~"Fungi")+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        text=element_text(face="bold"))+
  ylab("Cluster's cumulative relative abundance (%)")+
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion())+
  
  plot_layout(guides="collect",axes='collect')
```

```{r}
# create trans_beta object
# For PCoA and NMDS, measure parameter must be provided.
# measure parameter should be either one of names(mt_rarefied$beta_diversity) or a customized symmetric matrix
soil_16s_hell <- clone(soil_16s)
rownames(soil_16s_hell$tax_table) <- soil_16s_hell$tax_table$label
soil_16s_hell$otu_table <- t(labdsv::hellinger(t(soil_16s_hell$otu_table)))
soil_16s_hell$cal_betadiv(method = "horn")
soil_16s_hell$sample_table <- mutate(soil_16s_hell$sample_table,Trtmt=forcats::fct_relevel(Trtmt,c("P","I","R")))
t1 <- trans_beta$new(dataset = soil_16s_hell, group = "Trtmt", measure = "horn")

t1$cal_ordination(method = "PCoA")
# t1$res_ordination is the ordination result list
class(t1$res_ordination)
# plot the PCoA result with confidence ellipse
soilbac <- 
t1$plot_ordination(plot_color = "Trtmt", plot_type = c("point"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#ffe1b0","#6b5e49","#0f0d0a"), 
                     labels=c("Poor","Intermediate","Rich"),
                     name="Soils")+
  theme(text=element_text(face="bold"))+
  ggtitle("Bacteria")
```

```{r}
Stat_Frame <- matrix(0,18,4)
data2 <- data_leaf[,c(1:5,Nbcol[-14])]
col_idx <- 5
for ( i in data2[,c(6:23)]){
  col_idx <- col_idx + 1
  name <- names(data2[col_idx])
  row <- as.numeric(match(name, names(data2)))
  #kruskal
  a <- kruskal.test(i~data2$Trtmt)
  chi2kw <- a$statistic[[1]]
  df <- a$parameter[[1]]
  pval <- a$p.value
  Stat_Frame[row-5, 1] <- name
  Stat_Frame[row-5, 2] <- df
  Stat_Frame[row-5, 3] <- chi2kw
  Stat_Frame[row-5, 4] <- pval
}

colnames(Stat_Frame) <- c("var","df","chi2","krusk_pval")


Mean_sd_Frame <- matrix(0,18,15)
col_idx <- 5
for ( i in data2[,c(6:23)]){
  col_idx <- col_idx + 1
  name <- names(data2[col_idx])
  moy <- as.numeric(tapply(i,data2$Trtmt,mean,na.rm = T))
  sd <- as.numeric(tapply(i,data2$Trtmt,sd,na.rm = T))
  row <- as.numeric(match(name, names(data2)))
  mean_glob <- as.numeric(mean(i,na.rm = T))
  sd_glob <- as.numeric(sd(i,na.rm = T))
  coef_var <- (sd_glob/mean_glob)*100
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,1] <- name
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,2] <- signif(moy[1],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,4] <- signif(moy[2],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,6] <- signif(moy[3],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,8] <- signif(moy[4],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,10] <- signif(moy[5],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,12] <- signif(moy[6],digits = 3)
  
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,3] <- signif(sd[1],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,5] <- signif(sd[2],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,7] <- signif(sd[3],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,9] <- signif(sd[4],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,11] <- signif(sd[5],digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,13] <- signif(sd[6],digits = 3)
  
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,14] <- signif(mean_glob,digits = 3)
  Mean_sd_Frame[row-5,15] <- signif(sd_glob,digits = 3)
  
}
```

```{r}
letter_comp <- matrix(0,18,7)

col_idx <- 5
for (i in data2[,c(6:23)]){
  
  col_idx <- col_idx + 1
  cld_vec <- pairwise_letterZ(data2,data2$Trtmt,i)
  # cld_vec <- cld_vec[[1]]
  name <- names(data2[col_idx])
  row <- as.numeric(match(name, names(data2)))
  
  a <- ifelse(kruskal.test(i,data2$Trtmt)$p.value<0.05,1,0) 
  
  
  letter_comp[row-5,1] <- name
  ifelse(a==1,letter_comp[row-5,2] <- cld_vec[1],letter_comp[row-5,2] <- " ")
  ifelse(a==1,letter_comp[row-5,3] <- cld_vec[2],letter_comp[row-5,3] <- " ")
  ifelse(a==1,letter_comp[row-5,4] <- cld_vec[3],letter_comp[row-5,4] <- " ")
  ifelse(a==1,letter_comp[row-5,5] <- cld_vec[4],letter_comp[row-5,5] <- " ")
  ifelse(a==1,letter_comp[row-5,6] <- cld_vec[5],letter_comp[row-5,6] <- " ")
  ifelse(a==1,letter_comp[row-5,7] <- cld_vec[6],letter_comp[row-5,7] <- " ")
}

letter_df <- as.data.frame(letter_comp)
names(letter_df) <- c("var","P-D","I-D","R-D","P-W","I-W","R-W")
```

## Stat

###PCA permanova

```{r}
#check the hypothesis that dispersion is roughly the same between my groups in multivariate space
dis <- vegdist(data_leaf[,Nbcol[-c(14)]],method="euclidean") #we create a distance matrix between our individuals
mod <- betadisper(dis,data_leaf$Trtmt) #we calculate the multivarite dispersions i.e. average distance to centroids
anova(mod) #now we check that they are no difference between our groups i.e. our idnividuals have the same dispersion in the multivariate space

#p-value = 0.01049   significative so our group dispersion is heterogeneous between habitats
k = 1000
adon.res1 <- adonis2(scale(data_leaf[,Nbcol[-c(14)]])~data_leaf$Trtmt, perm = k, na.rm = T, method = "euclidean",p.adjust.methods="holm" ) 
adon.res1%>%
  flextable::flextable()%>%
  flextable::save_as_image(path="results/stats/permanova_pca.png")
```

```{r}
pair.adon.res1 <- pairwiseAdonis::pairwise.adonis(scale(data_leaf[,Nbcol[-c(14)]]),data_leaf$Trtmt,p.adjust.m = "holm", sim.method = "euclidean", perm=k)
pair.adon.res1%>%
    mutate(SumsOfSqs=round(SumsOfSqs,digits = 3),
                          R2=round(R2,digits = 3),
         F.Model=round(F.Model,digits = 3),
         p.value=ifelse(p.value<0.0001,"<0.0001",round(p.value,digits = 3)),
         p.adjusted=ifelse(p.adjusted<0.0001,"<0.0001",round(p.adjusted,digits = 3)))%>%
  select(-sig)%>%
    flextable::flextable()%>%
    flextable::bold(i=~`p.adjusted`<0.05,j=7)%>%
  flextable::save_as_docx(path="results/figures/draft/supp/table/TS1.docx")
```

```{r}
flextable::save_as_docx(flex_dbrda_16s,path="results/stats/TS6.docx")

flex_dbrda_its <- res_dbrda_its_margin %>%
  flextable::flextable()%>%
  flextable::fontsize(size=8, part = "body")%>%
  flextable::height_all(height = .1 ) %>%
  
  flextable::align(align = "center", part = "all")%>%

  flextable::add_footer_lines(values = "ANOVA summary table for Fungi dbRDA (Morisita-Horn distance on Hellinger transformed fungal communities). For each trait the F statistic, the % of total inertia explained and associated P-value (bold when significant, α<0.05). This output was obtained with set.seed(973) for reproducibility. The global ANOVA on fungal dbRDA model (Table S5) was NOT significant and trait significance should not be interpreted here.")%>%
  flextable::fontsize(part = "footer", size=6)%>%
  flextable::set_table_properties(width=0)

flextable::save_as_docx(flex_dbrda_its,path="results/stats/TS7.docx")
```

```{r}
micro_16s$otu_table%>%
    mutate(label=rownames(micro_16s$otu_table))%>%
    reshape2::melt()%>%
    group_by(label)%>%
    summarise(value=sum(value))%>%
    left_join(mutate(micro_16s$tax_table,label=rownames(micro_16s$tax_table)))%>%
    group_by(Class)%>%
    summarise(value=sum(value),
              count=n())%>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(relab=(value/sum(micro_16s$otu_table))*100,
           relcount=(count/nrow(micro_16s$otu_table))*100)%>%
    arrange(desc(relab))%>%
  mutate(Class=ifelse(Class=="c__","unknown",gsub("c__","",Class)))%>%
  dplyr::rename(Class=Class,
         Tot_reads=value,
         Unique_sequence=count,
         Proportion_reads=relab,
         Proportion_sequences=relcount)%>%
  write.csv2("results/figures/draft/supp/table/TS3.csv",row.names = F)
```

```{r}
cum_relab_lm$micro_16s$data%>%
  rbind(cum_relab_lm$micro_its$data)%>%
  select(marker,cleannames,cluster,r2,coeff_est,pval_tmp) %>%
  filter(cleannames!="C/N")%>%
  mutate(r2=round(r2,digits = 3),
         coeff_est=round(coeff_est,digits = 3),
         pval_tmp=ifelse(pval_tmp<0.0001,"<0.0001",round(pval_tmp,digits = 3)),
         cleannames=as.character(cleannames))%>%
  
  group_by(marker,cleannames)%>%
  mutate(n=row_number())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(cleannames=ifelse(n==1,cleannames,""))%>%
  select(-n)%>%
  
  group_by(marker)%>%
  mutate(n=row_number())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(marker=ifelse(n==1,gsub("micro_","",marker),""))%>%
  select(-n)%>%
  
  rename(Variables=cleannames,
         `Microbial clusters`=cluster,
         R2=r2,
         Estimate=coeff_est,
         `P-value`=pval_tmp)%>%
  flextable::flextable()%>%
  flextable::bold(i=~`P-value`<0.05,j=6)%>%
  flextable::width(j=1:6,width = c(2,4,3,2.5,2.5,4),unit = "cm")%>%
  flextable::align(align = "center", part = "all")%>%
  flextable::add_footer_lines(values = "Summary table of the linear models fitted between microbial cluster cumulative abundance and plant traits for all 18 traits. Results are shown for bot 16s and ITS markers. Microbial clusters are Bac 1,2 and 3 for bacteria and Fung 1,2,3 and 4 for fungi as shown in Fig 3. R2 and Estimate are the R-squared and coefficient estimate of the linear models. Significant P-values (α<0.05) are displayed in bold. Traits are: Number of leaves, Plant height (cm),  longest leaf length (leaf length, cm), longest leaf width (leaf width, cm) , leaf Soluble sugars, Carbon, Nitrogen and Phosphorus content (mg mg-1), leaf chlorophyll content (Chlorophyll, mg g-1), maximum quantum yield of photosystem II (Fv/Fm), maximum electron transport rate (ETRmax, µmol photon m-2 s-1), Number of Flowers, leaf mass area (LMA, gm-2),  leaf dry matter content (LDMC, g g-1), Stomatal density (Stomata mm-2), Midday leaf water potential (Water potential, MPa) and relative water content (RWC, %).")%>%
  flextable::fontsize(part = "footer", size=6)%>%
flextable::save_as_docx(path="results/figures/draft/supp/table/TS8.docx")
```

## Info on diablo OTU

### Info on slctd otus

```{r}
for(i in datasets){
  data_tmp <- get(i)
  data_tmp <- clone(data_tmp)
  
  taxo_tmp <- data_tmp$tax_table%>%
    mutate(OTUs=gsub("M","",rownames(.)))%>%
    filter(OTUs%in% info_paper_diablo[[i]]$otus$cleannames)
  
  taxo_tmp$sequences <- gsub("s__","",data_tmp$ori_tax$sequence[which(rownames(data_tmp$ori_tax)%in%paste0("M",info_paper_diablo[[i]]$otus$cleannames))])
  taxo_tmp$reads <- data_tmp$otu_table[which(rownames(data_tmp$otu_table)%in%paste0("M",info_paper_diablo[[i]]$otus$cleannames)),]%>%
    rowSums()
  taxo_tmp$prevalence <- rowSums(data_tmp$otu_table[which(rownames(data_tmp$otu_table)%in%paste0("M",info_paper_diablo[[i]]$otus$cleannames)),]>0)
  
  
  if(grepl("16s",i)){
    fct_df <- func16sdf[,order(colSums(func16sdf),decreasing = T)]%>%
      mutate(OTUs=gsub("M","",rownames(.)))
  }else{
    fct_df <- micro_its$taxfun_table %>%
      mutate(OTUs=gsub("M","",rownames(.)))
  }
  
  taxo_tmp%<>%left_join(fct_df)
  taxo_tmp%<>%left_join(dplyr::rename(dplyr::select(filter(pcirc_list[[i]]$data,grepl("OTU",cleannames)),cleannames,otu_group),OTUs=cleannames))
  
  taxo_tmp%<>%
    relocate(OTUs,otu_group)
  
  write.csv(taxo_tmp,paste0("results/stats//otu_info_diablo_",i,".csv"),row.names = F)
}
```
